$comment: Społeczność (src/server/community.js, screens/community.js). sections: the parts of its drop-down list, in their order (the Czat is not one of them since 0.2.40, the author: „tylko z zakładki”; it opens from the round chat button over the game, src/client/chat-bubble.js, and on a computer stands in the side column); soon marks one that is not open yet („Wkrótce”). ranking.page: how many characters a page of the Ranking postaci shows, and guilds a page of the guilds' Ranking (the author, 10.11.2026: „Ranking max 50 postaci + przewijanie listy na dalsze pozycje strona po stronie”); also the most a request may ask for. friends.max: the most Znajomi a character may have, and the most invitations it may have waiting. gift: the daily Upominek to a friend (one a day to each, by the Warsaw day). The receiver collects at most claimsPerDay a day, so as many Time Points too; one not collected waits keepDays days. Each gives timePoints Time Points and, at random, gold (goldChance) or one resource, more with the receiver's level: base + perLevel × level, rounded. trade: the Wymiana (src/server/trades.js). A player is online when the game asked the server within onlineSeconds; a proposal waits proposalSeconds for its answer and a trade idleMinutes for its next change; after rejectionsInRow proposals to one player turned down in a row the next waits pauseMinutes; an offer holds at most maxItems items from the bag.

discord.$comment: Discord (src/client/discord.js): invite is the game's server invite link (https://discord.gg/… or https://discord.com/invite/…), empty while there is none. With a link, the Discord mark by the Społeczność's title and a Discord row in the Ustawienia open it in a new card; without one, neither shows. texts.join: the words of the row's button and of the mark.
